c: Death Spiral shoots out nine red spinning scythes around the player. Each scythe has extremely high Pierce and are bigger, with damage reduction to compensate. It also has a slower
which make them stay on screen for longer.
Death Spiral scales with the character's

stat multiplied by 1.2, decreased by 0.1 compared to Axe. While this may seem like a downside, Death Spiral base Area is increased and in total it gives a multiplier of 1.44. Also, Area bonuses from the character is capped at 10 times the base value. In the end, Axe will still cap at 10 times bigger the original and Death Spiral will cap at 12 times bigger.

The fixed direction of the scythes is vastly different compared to the arcing behavior of
. While the consistency makes Death Spiral easier to understand and use, the player will no longer be able to focus all of the axes directly north into enemies for easy damage.
However, as the player moves in one direction, the scythes on screen will never despawn. If the
, more and more scythes can be stacked and become a wall of damage up until the weapon's Pool Limit.
Death Spiral's scythes benefit greatly from
bonuses as they are big already and even have a bonus multiplier. The bigger they are, the more enemies they will be able to pierce through. Luckily,
bonuses are very effective for Death Spiral, because of its slow cooldown.
bonuses are also highly effective, due to the bonuses being applied to a weapon with already very high base damage.
bonuses cause scythes to cover more screen area and reduce blind spots.
Death Spiral can deal critical damage after
the player has, the more likely they are to deal critical hits.
, it is possible to obtain Axe in addition to Death Spiral. However, it cannot be evolved into Death Spiral.
, the player can freeze enemies and stand directly on top of them to maximize damage, as the projectiles spawn on top of the enemies.
